scope.summary: Add an 'Archive thread' action to the Discussions sidebar so old threads can be hidden without deletion. The acceptance criteria below are the ones product wrote — keep them verbatim.

proposedTasks.title: Add archive action to thread row context menu
acceptanceCriteria: Right-clicking a thread row shows an 'Archive' menu item
Selecting Archive moves the thread to the 'Archived' collapsible section
Archived threads remain searchable but are hidden from the default list
